facts.text: Andrew and Audrey enjoyed pastries at a cafe, which Andrew photographed and shared with Audrey.

evidence.quote: They taste great too! We had some delicious croissants, muffins, and tarts! It was amazing!
Yep, I got them! Check out this photo of the delicious pastries we had at the cafe.

facts.text: Audrey mentioned making her favorite treats last week and suggested having a pastry party.

evidence.quote: Since you mentioned pastries, I made some of my favorite treats last week. Let's have a pastry party sometime!

facts.text: Andrew expressed enthusiasm for the pastry party and agreed to attend.

evidence.quote: That looks delicious! A pastry party sounds awesome, count me in!

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that her dogs would attend the pastry party.

evidence.quote: Awesome! My dogs will tag along. My furry friends would love it!
